company.shortDescription: Qarrib is an IT Internet firm offering a SaaS marketplace for Groceries.
company.description: Powering Local Commerce on Both Sides of the Counter.  From ordering your daily groceries to helping neighborhood shops grow online — Qarrib connects merchants and customers into one seamless, community-driven platform. Qarrib's mission is to give a platform to everyday Baqalas. We are on a mission to revolutionise the micro grocery market by bringing the corner shops in the 21st century. arrib was built on three key beliefs. Bring the local shops back to life by end to end modernization, supporting small businesses and creating sustainability. We aim to make an impact in the everyday lives of our communities across the GCC.
